title: Accounts Payable Clerk
company: Blusource Professional Services Ltd - Agency - Temporary
description:
Accounts Payable Specialist / Purchase Ledger Clerk

Location: Lincoln, Lincolnshire
Contract: Temporary, 3 to 6 months
Salary: £14 - £17 per hour depending on experience, PAYE
Start Date: Immediate

Blusource Recruitment is working with a well-established, multifaceted business based just outside Lincoln to recruit an experienced Accounts Payable Specialist for an initial 3 to 6 month temporary assignment.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Purchase Ledger Clerk, Accounts Payable Assistant, AP Clerk or Purchase Ledger Assistant who enjoys working in a busy finance environment and can quickly become a valuable member of an established team.

The business is entering one of its busiest periods of the year and requires someone confident in managing accounts payable responsibilities independently, supporting the wider finance function and assisting with external audit requirements.

The Role

As an Accounts Payable Specialist, you will be responsible for:
- Supporting the day-to-day accounts payable and purchase ledger function.
- Processing supplier invoices accurately and efficiently.
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving discrepancies.
- Responding to supplier queries and liaising with internal departments.
- Supporting payment processes and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Assisting with external audit requests and providing supporting documentation.
- Helping the finance team manage increased workloads during a particularly busy period.

About You

We are keen to speak with experienced Accounts Payable Clerks, Purchase Ledger Clerks, AP Specialists, Accounts Assistants, Finance Assistants, Purchase Ledger Administrators and Accounts Payable Officers who have:
- Substantial hands-on accounts payable or purchase ledger experience.
- The confidence to work independently with minimal supervision.
- Strong attention to detail and good organisational skills.
- A positive, proactive attitude and a willingness to support colleagues.
- Immediate or short-notice availability.

This opportunity is particularly suited to someone who enjoys temporary assignments and can commit to the full contract.

Interested? Apply today or contact Blusource Recruitment for a confidential discussion about the opportunity.

title: Bookkeeper - Practice
description:
Bookkeeper
Spalding (office based)
£26,000 - £31,000

A well-established accountancy practice in Spalding is seeking an experienced Bookkeeper to join its friendly and supportive team. This is a varied client-facing role offering genuine autonomy, with responsibility for managing your own workload and supporting a portfolio of clients across their bookkeeping and accounting needs. The role would suit an experienced practice bookkeeper looking to gain greater variety and responsibility.

Role Responsibilities
- Preparing bookkeeping records for a varied portfolio of clients.
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns.
- Completing bank and control account reconciliations.
- Reviewing client records and identifying queries or discrepancies.
- Preparing accounts to trial balance stage.
- Assisting with interim and management information.
- Liaising directly with clients to obtain information and resolve bookkeeping queries.
- Working with cloud accounting software, including Xero.
- Supporting the wider accounts and taxation team.
- Managing your own workload and ensuring deadlines are met.

Personal Requirements
- Good bookkeeping experience, ideally gained within an accountancy practice.
- Experience preparing VAT returns.
- Strong understanding of double-entry bookkeeping.
- Experience reconciling balance sheet accounts.
- Confidence communicating directly with clients.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage deadlines.
- Ability to work independently and take responsibility for your own work.
- Positive attitude and willingness to support colleagues.
- Experience preparing accounts to trial balance would be advantageous.
- AAT qualified, studying towards AAT, or qualified by experience.
- Experience with Xero would be particularly useful.
- Full, unrestricted right to work in the UK. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Benefits
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Free on-site parking.
- Ongoing CPD and professional development.
- Genuine autonomy over your workload.
- Direct client contact.
- Annual team away day.
- Friendly and supportive working environment.

If you are an experienced Bookkeeper looking for a varied role within accountancy practice, with greater autonomy and direct client responsibility, apply today.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant

Location: Lincoln

Salary: £30,000 per annum

Vacancy Type: Full Time Monday- Friday 7.30-16.30 (1 day Hybrid after probation)

Job Purpose

We are seeking an experienced and highly organised Finance Assistant to join our team. Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, this role will take responsibility for a broad range of transactional finance duties and play a key role in supporting the smooth running of the finance function. This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive individual with strong attention to detail and previous experience in a busy finance environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Management of aged receivables and aged payables
- Credit control
- Daily bank postings and bank reconciliations
- Supplier & Customer statement reconciliations
- Processing staff and director expenses
- Assisting with month-end procedures and reporting
- Supporting with ad hoc duties as required
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring data integrity
- Qualifications
- Experience with ERP systems (e.g. Sage, Xero)
- Knowledge of UK VAT rules
- AAT qualification or working towards one (Desirable)

Skills & Experience - Essential
- Previous experience in a Finance Assistant or similar finance role
- Strong understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable processes
- Experience with credit control and reconciliations
- Good organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
- Ability to manage workload effectively and meet deadlines
- Confident communicator with a professional manner
- Competent Excel user

Personal Key Characteristics
- Reliable and trustworthy
- Self-motivated with a proactive approach
- Able to work independently and as part of a team
- Positive attitude and willingness to support colleagues
- Salary & Benefits
- Salary: £30k per annum
- Pension scheme enrolment
- Holiday entitlement: 21 days plus bank holidays
- One day working from home (managerial discretion)
- Training and development opportunities

Apply today to be part of a dynamic and growing organization that values you.

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Benjamin Edwards Ltd, please do not hesitate to apply.

title: Payroll Clerk & Accounts Assistant
description:
Payroll Clerk & Accounts Assistant

Location: Caistor

Full Time

Monday to Friday 9:00am - 4:30pm

Manpower are currently recruiting for a Payroll Clerk & Accounts Assistant on behalf of our client. This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established business where you'll play a key role in supporting payroll, accounts and administration functions within a close-knit and friendly team.

If you're an organised and detail-focused individual with payroll experience and a background in accounts support, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

As a Payroll Clerk & Accounts Assistant, you'll be responsible for ensuring payroll is processed accurately and on time, whilst also providing support across the wider finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Process weekly and monthly payroll accurately and within deadlines
- Maintain and update employee payroll records
- Check timesheets, holiday records, sickness absence and payroll data
- Respond to payroll-related queries from employees
- Process new starters and leavers
- Assist with pension administration and payroll submissions
- Prepare payroll reports and maintain payroll documentation
- Process employee expenses
- Process purchase and sales invoices
- Support accounts payable and accounts receivable activities
- Assist with general office administration duties
- Provide additional support to the finance team as required

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous payroll experience (essential)
- Experience within an accounts or bookkeeping environment
- Strong understanding of payroll processes and confidentiality requirements
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Office applications
- Experience using Sage Payroll and Sage Accounts (desirable)
- Ability to work independently and manage competing deadlines
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills
- A professional, positive and team-focused attitude

What's in it for You?
- Competitive salary of £27,000 - £34,000, dependent on experience
- Monday to Friday working hours, 9:00am - 4:30pm
- Paid 30-minute lunch break
- 22 days annual leave, plus an additional day off for your birthday
- Extra time off over Christmas while working within a skeleton staff rota
- Early finish at 12:30pm every other Friday
- Join a supportive team of just three people, where your contribution will be highly valued
- Laptop provided for office use
- Free onsite parking

Apply Today

If you're a dependable and trustworthy payroll professional looking for a varied role within a supportive and friendly team, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact the Manpower team for more information.

If you receive suspicious outreach claiming to be from us, please contact us via the ManpowerGroup website.
